ValidationRule.description: if stage is closed won or close lost, then the notes for next opportunity field is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordTypeId = '0123C000000Gxj7' && OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL( StageName, "Closed Lost")) && ISBLANK( Notes_for_Next_Opp__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closed Opportunity Requires Notes for Next Opportunity.
